response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.zoneref, si.riskeval, s.pressratio FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref), grouped AS (SELECT zoneref AS site_code, riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM matched GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval), shared AS (SELECT site_code, risk_evaluation_status, avg_pressratio, scan_count, scan_count * 1.0 / SUM(scan_count) OVER () AS share FROM grouped), ranked AS (SELECT shared.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS share_rank FROM shared) SELECT site_code, risk_evaluation_status, avg_pressratio, scan_count, share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Matching is an inner join of scans.zoneref to sites.zoneregistry, so unmatched scans are dropped; the foreign key means this drops nothing in practice.
A NULL riskeval is kept as its own risk-status group, and those scans count toward the total matched scans used as the share denominator.
Share is the group's scan count divided by the sum of all group counts (the total matched scans), computed as a decimal, not an integer division.
Top-10 with ties uses RANK() on share, so every group whose share equals the 10th-ranked share is kept; ties are exact because equal counts give equal shares.

alternatives.interpretation: Scans whose site has no risk evaluation status (riskeval IS NULL) are excluded before grouping, so they are not counted in any group or in the share denominator.
alternatives.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.zoneref, si.riskeval, s.pressratio FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE si.riskeval IS NOT NULL), grouped AS (SELECT zoneref AS site_code, riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM matched GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval), shared AS (SELECT site_code, risk_evaluation_status, avg_pressratio, scan_count, scan_count * 1.0 / SUM(scan_count) OVER () AS share FROM grouped), ranked AS (SELECT shared.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS share_rank FROM shared) SELECT site_code, risk_evaluation_status, avg_pressratio, scan_count, share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC
